propositions: Config key verify.overlap_enabled lacks documentation in docs/config.md and its name obscures that it gates an LLM-backed advisory duplicate-detector, not a blocking gate
The old TOML key and env var must remain functional forever as permanent aliases to avoid breaking existing project configs and deployed environments

Two back-compat registry rows (one TOML, one env) must be added with permanent=True and remove_in=None, using _permanent() and yielding message text containing 'permanent alias' not 'scheduled for removal'

All in-source reads (enrich_drain.py:233, plan_review/__init__.py:765, rebar.toml:39) must use the new canonical name suggest_duplicate_tickets; the old name survives only in four back-compat sites (_ALIASES, two _deprecations rows, _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES)

docs/config.md must document what the setting produces (up to three advisory link suggestions), its three execution stages, that it never blocks, and that cost scales with tracker size not ticket size
